Decision documented: PM2 MVP uses only one selected shell startscript per project; no free commands, ecosystem files, YAML parsing, framework detection, or port templates.

Implemented read-only project inventory: .nginx candidate discovery, server_name block parsing, per-project domains, enabled symlink status, symlink/path validation, conflict warnings, /api/projects JSON output, and dashboard rendering. Persistent project-specific selection remains covered by nc-91t and nc-69w.6 per existing design/dependencies.

Implemented SQLite persistence under /opt/nginx-config/nginx-conf.sqlite3 with audit log, action status/global lock, UI state, server IPs, project selections, and managed PM2 process registration. Added action_id helper validation metadata, result acknowledgement, excerpt limits, and policy rejection/schema tests preventing config contents, full diffs, and file hashes from being persisted.

Implemented project-specific selection state: PM2 startscript discovery for *.sh only with ignored cache/build dirs and no symlink following, auto-selection for single candidates, required-selection warnings for ambiguous/missing candidates, saved SQLite selections via validated API, dashboard/API exposure, and tests for single, ambiguous, missing, ignored, saved, and invalid candidates.

Implemented central allowlisted system action layer with fixed command builders, path/domain validation, subprocess runner with shell=False, SQLite action_id/global lock integration, structured stdout/stderr/exit handling, background-action records, read-only action status endpoints, expandable result banner, and sudoers/helper constraints documented in docs/technikreferenz.md. Tests cover command templates, path escapes, unsupported domains/PM2 ops, helper JSON stdin, lock collisions, status endpoints, and audit/status persistence.

Implemented root-helper CLI module and scripts/nginx-conf-helper wrapper for fixed subcommands write-config, reset-config-to-head, and commit-config. Helper reads JSON from stdin, validates action_id read-only against SQLite, checks active status/subcommand/project/config/expected file and saved project selection, validates /opt/www path and Git scope, writes/resets/commits only the selected *.nginx file, returns structured JSON with action_id, diff stats or commit hash, and never writes status/audit SQLite data. Tests cover valid/invalid JSON, config content in JSON without SQLite persistence, forbidden tempfile/hash/diff fields, missing/unknown/mismatched action_id, wrong project/config, path escapes, dirty foreign changes, multi-file rejection, missing Git repo, reset and single-file commit scope.

Implemented Git workflow for selected project configs: read-only Git status, commit-required detection, foreign dirty-file visibility, selected-file live diff, commit/reset service using the nc-uud helper contract, SQLite action lock/status/audit updates, API endpoints for status/diff/commit/reset, and dashboard Git status. Tests cover clean/dirty repos, selected config changes, foreign changes not committed, helper rejection, active-action lock collision, missing Git repo, and API status.

Implemented read-only SSL status from Certbot/Let's Encrypt renewal data. The app parses renewal configs, decodes certificate SAN/CN and notAfter via stdlib, maps certificates to project domains, reports cert paths, expiry date, relative days, warning states valid/yellow/red/critical/expired/missing/error, surfaces unassigned Certbot lineages, exposes /api/ssl and includes SSL status in /api/projects and dashboard. Tests cover renewal parsing, decoded SAN override, expired/critical/red/yellow/valid/missing states, paths, serialization, and unassigned lineages.

Implemented read-only DNS preflight for Certbot server_name groups. The service reads explicitly configured public server IPs from SQLite, resolves A/AAAA records via an injectable resolver, blocks missing A records, foreign A records, existing AAAA records without configured IPv6, foreign AAAA records, and missing server IPv4 configuration, exposes /api/dns/preflight, and serializes results for banners/Certbot flow. Tests cover matching A/AAAA, missing records, foreign IPv4/IPv6, existing AAAA without IPv6 config, mixed groups, missing server-IP configuration, serialization, and API wiring without live DNS.

Implemented nginx -t and Nginx reload UI/API actions. /api/nginx/test runs the allowlisted nginx-test command through the system action layer, returns exitcode/stdout/stderr, records status/audit, and stores a successful-test gate in SQLite UI state. /api/nginx/reload runs the allowlisted systemctl reload nginx command only after a successful nginx -t gate and uses the global action lock. Dashboard exposes simple action forms. Tests cover success output, reload gate rejection, reload after successful test, and lock conflict handling.
PM2 read-only status via pm2 jlist added with project assignment, SQLite-managed marker, warnings for unmanaged/foreign processes, UI/API output, and tests.
Implemented static Django ALLOWED_HOSTS healthcheck with dashboard warnings, API payload, commit/reload blockers, and tests for matching, missing, non-Django, and dynamic settings.

Implemented MVP bootstrap auth: setup-only mode before first user, server-side setup-token file, token invalidation, first user creation, DNS server IP persistence, HttpOnly session cookie, route protection, docs, and tests.
Added pytest to pre-commit with pass_filenames=false, documented hook flow and --no-verify escape hatch, and verified pre-commit run --all-files.
Added systemd unit, sudoers snippet, deployment documentation, reference in technical docs, and tests ensuring unprivileged service user and fixed sudo commands.

Implemented config activate/deactivate via fixed helper subcommands, project-scoped sites-enabled symlink validation, API orchestration with nginx -t gate, dashboard buttons, sudoers/docs updates, and tests.
